questions.question: The sum of the current ages of Vishal and Armaan is 70 years. 5 years ago, Vishal was twice as old as Armaan. What is Armaan’s current age?
questions.solution:
Let Arman’s current age is = X

Vishal’s current age = 70 - X

Arman’s age 5 years ago = X - 5

Vishal’s age 5 years ago = 70 - X - 5 = 65 - X

According to condition given is question

2(X - 5) = 65 - X

2X - 10 = 65 - X

3X = 75

X = 25

Hence, Arman’s current age is 25 years.

questions.question:
Which letter will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

X, R, ?, I, F, D, C
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

X - 6 = R

**R - 5 = M**

M - 4 = I

I - 3 = F

F - 2 = D

D - 1 = C

Hence, M is the answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

4 × 5 - 24 ÷ 12 + 8 = 14
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and -

4 × 5 + 24 ÷ 12 - 8 = 20 + 2 - 8

**22 - 8 = 14**

Interchanging ÷ and ×

4 div 5 - 24 times 12 + 8 = (4)/(5) - 288 + 8

(4)/(5) - 296 ne 14

Interchanging × and +

4 + 5 - 24 ÷ 12 × 8 = 9 - 2 × 8

9 - 16 ≠ 14

Interchanging + and ÷

4 times 5 - 24 + 12 div 8 = 20 - 24 + (3)/(2)

- 4 + (3)/(2) ne 14

Hence by interchanging + and - we get correct equation.

questions.question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’

If V + S × Q - P ÷ T + R × U, then how is R related to S?
questions.solution:
V + S means V is the sister of S

S × Q means S is the mother of Q

Q - P means Q is the brother of P

P ÷ T means P is the father of T

T + R means T is the sister of R

R × U means R is the mother of U

questions.question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and one is different. Pick the odd one out.
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

G+ 1 = H, H + 3 = K, K + 4 = O, O + 5 = T

P + 1 = Q, Q + 3 = T, T + 4 = X, X + 5 = C

U + 1 = V, V + 3 = Y, Y + 4 = C, C + 5 = H

Hence JKNRV is the odd among the given letters.

questions.question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true. Even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statement:**

All drums are sticks.

Some drums are boxes.

**Conclusions: **

I. Some boxes are sticks.

II. Some sticks are drums.

III. All sticks are drums.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
All the conclusions, I, II and III follow

questions.solution:
Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/992c57ce2556082d68e9e3f8e09d1f2ba157074a4f7425188dfd977bcb3f5106.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boxes are sticks → True.

II. Some sticks are drums → True.

III. All sticks are drums → False (It is possible but not definite).

Hence, only conclusions I and II follow.

Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

questions.solution:

Second number = First number × (First number + 1)

9 × 10 = 90

Similarly

12 × 13 = 156

Hence 156 is the correct answer.
